```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
library(viridis)
```

## Read and prep data

```{r data}
calls <- read.csv("~/Desktop/LIFEDAT/call_data_12October2025.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
calls <- calls[, -1]
calls$Species <- as.factor(calls$Species)
str(calls)
table(calls$Species)
```

## Hyperparameter grid search 

```{r grid-search}
set.seed(123)
n_predictors <- ncol(calls) - 1

rf_grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry     = seq(2, n_predictors, by = 1),
  ntree    = c(100, 300, 500, 700, 1000),
  nodesize = c(1, 3, 5)
)
rf_grid$OOB_error <- NA_real_

for (i in seq_len(nrow(rf_grid))) {
  fit <- randomForest(
    Species ~ .,
    data       = calls,
    mtry       = rf_grid$mtry[i],
    ntree      = rf_grid$ntree[i],
    nodesize   = rf_grid$nodesize[i],
    importance = FALSE
  )
  rf_grid$OOB_error[i] <- fit$err.rate[nrow(fit$err.rate), "OOB"]
}

head(rf_grid[order(rf_grid$OOB_error), ], 10)
```

## Best hyperparameters

```{r best-params}
best_params <- rf_grid[which.min(rf_grid$OOB_error), ]
best_params

best_mtry     <- best_params$mtry
best_ntree    <- best_params$ntree
best_nodesize <- best_params$nodesize
```

## Final model

```{r final-model}
set.seed(123)
final_rf <- randomForest(
  Species ~ .,
  data       = calls,
  mtry       = best_mtry,
  ntree      = best_ntree,
  nodesize   = best_nodesize,
  importance = TRUE,
  proximity  = TRUE
)
final_rf
```

## Variable importance

```{r var-importance}
importance_df <- as.data.frame(importance(final_rf))
importance_df$Variable <- rownames(importance_df)

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Variable, MeanDecreaseGini),
                          y = MeanDecreaseGini)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease in Gini)",
    x = "Predictor",
    y = "Mean Decrease Gini"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Predicted class probabilities

```{r predicted-probs}
pred_probs <- as.data.frame(predict(final_rf, type = "prob"))
pred_probs$Observation <- 1:nrow(pred_probs)
pred_probs$Actual_Species <- calls$Species

pred_probs_long <- pred_probs %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Observation, Actual_Species),
    names_to = "Predicted_Species",
    values_to = "Probability"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Actual_Species, Observation)

pred_probs_long$Observation <- factor(
  pred_probs_long$Observation,
  levels = unique(pred_probs_long$Observation)
)

ggplot(pred_probs_long, aes(x = Observation, y = Predicted_Species, fill = Probability)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "magma", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_grid(~ Actual_Species, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Class Probabilities by Observation",
    subtitle = "Faceted by true (actual) species",
    x = "Observation",
    y = "Predicted Species Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```
